description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be longer than 64 characters.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请先确保服务商在创建服务时配置了重启的运维操作。
descriptions.en:
### Prerequisites

Ensure that the service provider enabled the restart O\&M operation when the service was created.
